card: Marks bitcoin-build-config.h with IWYU pragma: always_keep and removes redundant IWYU pragma: keep comments from all files that include it via a scripted-diff. Previously, every inclusion required an inline keep pragma to satisfy include-what-you-use tooling, cluttering include lists and obscuring genuine one-off pragmas that need review. This is an internal cleanup with no dependencies.
evidence: PR description: 'grepping for `IWYU pragma: keep` returns only the genuine use cases, each of which should be properly documented.'
problem: Every file including `bitcoin-build-config.h` had to carry an inline `// IWYU pragma: keep` comment to avoid removal by Include-What-You-Use tooling. This cluttered source files and obscured genuine, non-standard uses of the keep pragma during code searches.

risk.why: A typo in the scripted diff or linter script could cause IWYU or the C++ linter to report false positives during CI.

scope_notes: A scripted-diff across 65 files modifying header inclusions, `cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in`, and `test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_cpp.rs`.
summary: Marks `bitcoin-build-config.h` with `IWYU pragma: always_keep` and removes redundant per-include `IWYU pragma: keep` annotations across the codebase. It also updates the C++ linter to remove stale instructions regarding the pragma.
